notes.title: Development Plan for 'Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross' V1.0.04 Version
notes.notes:
Hi Fellows!

"Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross" has been officially launched on Steam for four days now, and we want to express our deep gratitude for the support and attention we've received from our knights! In this period, we've received numerous feedback and suggestions from our passionate knights. The production team has diligently discussed all collected feedback, and based on the current version's conditions, we have outlined our development plan.

We anticipate rolling out the upcoming version to our test server within this week. Additionally, we invite all our knights to assist us in testing and providing feedback. Once the version is confirmed stable, we will promptly update it to the official version. (please join [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/RnrFFfHjT2][b]Discord[/b][/url])

Please find the development plan as below:

[b]1. Addition of the Relic Backpack, and Optimization of Sacred Relic Catalog Inclusion Logic[/b]
An additional feature, the 'Sacred Relic Backpack', will be introduced. Users can select whichever Sacred Relic they deem suitable to activate at any time. Furthermore, all Sacred Relics that are added to the backpack will also be included in the catalog.

[b]2.I Inherit Ally Levels in Game Cycles[/b]
The levels of your allies will be preserved, just like the knight's level. They will not reset due to cycling through the game.

[b]3. Addition of New Cards[/b]
In response to the current game mechanism, 24 new cards with various effects will be added to enrich diversity in deck building.

[b]4. Addition of an Exclusive Store for Multiple Playthroughs[/b]
Targeting multiple playthroughs, once the side story with a team member is completed and the exclusive card and sacred relic have been obtained, an exclusive store will be unlocked. This store allows direct purchases once unlocked.

[b]5. Open Level-up Stages[/b]
The refresh of leveling tasks will no longer require death, you can directly activate leveling tasks for training at the Camp NPC uncle.

[b]6. Recall Feature for Recruited Teammates[/b]
Recall functionality will be activated for teammates who have previously been recruited and released. You can recall corresponding teammates at Mayael.

[b]7. BUG Fixes and Prompt Optimization[/b]
We are swiftly addressing BUGs and content feedback from our knights. Before unlocking features, TIPS prompts will be added. (Details of the BUG fixes will be listed in update announcements afterwards)

notes.title: “Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross” Raises its Battle Flag and Launches Today
notes.notes:
Hi Fellows!

Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross, which is releasing today on Steam! Step back into the age of knights and noble lords , go on a journey with this story-driven deckbuilding RPG featuring more than 30 unique teammates, each with their own special skills and stories. 

Experience the epic 15th century struggle of the Polish-Lithuanian Alliance against the Teutonic Knights, as was told in the Nobel Prize winning novel Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross. To help even further immerse players in the world of the book western-style Character Portraits are being added as free DLC alongside the launch of the game. These new characters portraits add a more serious air to the events of the story for those who crave that extra authenticity.

Build your team, build your deck, and take to the field today with [b]Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross[/b], [b]available now on Steam for $15.99 USD[/b] with a [b]10% off[/b] launch discount!

https://youtu.be/qKgZhoeYgQ0

https://youtu.be/-g2_RTUAOK4

[b]About Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross[/b]

In a story is adapted from the Nobel Prize-winning work “Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross” by Henryk Sienkiewicz, you'll experience the life and death struggles between the Polish-Lithuanian people and the aggressive Teutonic Knights of the 15th century.

Play as a knight, embark on the medieval adventure, search for companions, collect diverse cards, and help Polish-Lithuanian Alliance defeat the Teutonic Knights in the Battle of Grunwald.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/ca3143f0c1debab1008fb38b4bf3043c2584228d.gif[/img]

[b]Key features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Teammate skills play a crucial role in combat, with how you play your hand triggering those skills.
[*] More than 30 teammates can be recruited and leveled up. All of which have unique skills and storylines of their own.
[*] Build your own combat style with different cards, teammates, and relics, ensuring no run is the same.
[*] Experience a massive, epic medieval adventure with 7 chapters and over 200 side requests and events.
[*] Once you're done with the main campaign, there is a roguelite mode providing more even challenges and replayability
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/630f7574691ff9703cdb3590c2d08d14ed51acec.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 《十字军骑士》新人指南，你想知道的都在这里
notes.notes:
各位尊敬的骑士们大家好啊，我是吟游诗人小琪，很高兴又见面了。随着我们首次DEMO测试正式结束，《十字军骑士》将会加大马力，全速进入预发售前的准备阶段，我们将会以最大的诚意去打磨游戏，尽力带来优秀的游戏体验，也感谢长久以来一直支持我们的各位骑士们。

在DEMO测试结束后不久，小琪我也收到了好多骑士们反馈过来的问题，因此本次也特意准备了新人指南，就是为了解答各位骑士们的疑惑哦。


1.《十字军骑士》是一款什么样的游戏
简单版：打牌RPG游戏
豪华版：《十字军骑士》是一款以卡牌玩法为主的RPG角色扮演游戏（说人话就是打牌），在卡牌战斗的同时加入了伙伴技能连携系统，根据玩家打出的牌释放不同的专属技能从而构筑万千流派（三消Pro Plus Max版）。您将会在游戏中结识并招募到众多同伴（划重点，小姐姐超多），踏上一段波澜壮阔的旅程。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/42c2b654830800a21bf91aed450a5c3930d4775f.png[/img]

2.这款游戏是手游吗？
如假包换的PC单机游戏，不联网，不抽卡，一次买断不氪金，不过我们之后可能考虑会推出移动版本。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/e76180ae5cd691b95f5e6bc3dc49ee6bd4f0df75.png[/img]

3.游戏的特色和主要玩法是什么？
《十字军骑士》虽然是一款打牌游戏，但是招募的队友也同样重要，可以通过依次打出卡牌的种类，触发同伴的连携技能，不同队友也拥有不同的技能和定位，可以依照战局的不同进行策略性的选择。偷偷告诉你们一个小秘密，如果当局释放队友的终极大招，就会有好看的动态特效哦。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/05a28bd7ccf1523abaf28ba1d8f28c6c243f8eb1.png[/img]

4.队友可以让玩家去选择攻击目标吗？
队友系统无法让玩家自主选择攻击目标，不过由于不同技能拥有不同的攻击规则，比如有些同伴技能是攻击最近敌人，有的是攻击最远敌人，有的是攻击血最少的敌人。依靠策略性的调配，是可以做到“指哪打哪”的。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/d1e85f466868e1b74b96cd3413b909b44f133085.png[/img]

5.请问第二幕的NPC奶妈多大啊？
你猜！

6.为什么营地里有时候没有能招募的NPC？
营地里的NPC是随机到访的，具体可以从左下角的信息栏里看到当前到访NPC的信息。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/a652a5f8bf7b6c8647044efaf42c6149ed6bb981.png[/img]

7.圣遗物有什么用？我应该从哪获得？
圣遗物可以看作是游戏中的被动道具加成，不同功能的圣遗物还有不同的品级，可以通过配合同伴来打造自己的专属流派。目前除了商店购买之外，完成特殊剧情也会获得特殊的圣遗物，大部分同伴我们也加入了专属圣遗物，可以通过完成同伴任务获得。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/f6313d0650e94ab1f68d41d772cd177072f03db1.png[/img]

8.降低卡组下限到底是什么意思，为什么有时候我组的卡牌保存不了。
《十字军骑士》和一些卡牌游戏不同的是，有卡组下限数量的设计，玩家必须要带够一定数量的卡牌，这个卡组才会保存，而降低卡组下限数量则是可以让玩家带更少的牌，配合着同伴的技能系统，通过快速过牌和组合特定的卡牌排序，从而反复快速打出想要的技能组合。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/870e95fb447c20738193e12cb9bac9812512852d.png[/img]

9.后续上线之后还会有什么新玩法吗？
相信各位早已注意到了，主界面的肉鸽模式，目前这个模式我们还在打磨和优化，将会在游戏正式发售之后的一段时间内上线这个新模式，相信到时候会给各位带来不同的体验。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/1b98efb7368d5f7ad66b21b9a581a096c0fc81f6.png[/img]

10.我有一些问题和BUG，在哪能反馈？
欢迎加入我们的骑士QQ群729921218，对游戏有任何建议或意见，都欢迎来加群反馈哦。

11.这游戏什么时候发售，多少钱，我现在就要玩。
目前《十字军骑士》暂定于7月左右正式发售，具体时间请关注我们的后续信息。至于售价，小琪我拿人格保证，绝对是一个能让大家大呼良心的价格。我们将会在6月19日Steam新品节再次上架一个更加稳定的DEMO进行测试，各位小伙伴一定要记着来玩哦。

notes.title: 《十字军骑士》首次DEMO测试圆满结束，感谢所有参与的骑士们
notes.notes:
各位骑士们大家好啊，我是吟游诗人小琪，好久不见了。不知道大家对于首次测试的Demo感觉如何？无论好坏，喜欢的话请大声说出来，我们来者不拒，不喜欢的话也请轻喷，我们改，我们改还不行吗？

一周过得很快，从我们收集到的信息来看，游戏的整体评价比较正面，很多骑士们都对这款国产独游非常感兴趣，相应的，我们的愿望单数量也在猛增。总的来说，首次Demo测试的反馈我们也非常满意，老国王高兴地给我们每个人都加了鸡腿。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/15985dcdd6ef35457a07797c5b5b4a1b19ae0bf4.png[/img]

值得一提的是，我们听到最多的反馈就是：“那个奶妈能不能加入到招募队伍里？
这‘奶量’一看就是个大奶”。不过很遗憾的是，我们原定计划是没有把她做到招募队伍里的打算。不过既然各位骑士们已经发自内心提出了请求，我回去一定好好压力一下老国王。

除了骑士群讨论的热火朝天之外，我们还惊喜的发现B站的一些游戏UP主关注到了我们的游戏，并做了游戏直播视频，这让我们诚惶诚恐，特别是有一个UP主还“吐槽”我们的游戏，“感觉PV做的非常一般，结果游戏还挺好玩的”，我们在此特别声明：“没错，我们觉得你说得很对”。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/ca863beb41e247a24cfa598fd7e66aacc1111807.png[/img]

另外一个让我们比较欣喜的地方，是视频下的B站玩家们对我们的游戏非常感兴趣，整体的好评也集中在游戏的立绘上，不得不说，大家都“独具慧眼”。不过我们想说的是，作为一款国产卡牌游戏，我们也希望在玩法上能带给玩家更多的创新，虽然做不到标杆式的体验，但是我们希望除了立绘之外，游戏在玩法上也能让各位玩家感受到一些新鲜感。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/3ffcdfddadcf4b672bba158ebf7fe0f1815b9e08.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/c890c06a9df10f155fbc7ba68d7d4983f01f3096.png[/img]

至于各种问题反馈，我们也在积极的回复和汇总，希望各位骑士们再给我们一点时间。还有一部分新骑士对于这款国产游戏可能还存在一些疑问，我们也会在不久之后做一期QA汇总的文章，详细回复解答。

最后，再次感谢所有参与测试Demo的骑士们，无论评价好坏我们都虚心接受，并诚心改正。还有一部分可能错过首次Demo测试的骑士们也不要着急，我们将会在本月的Steam新品节拿出更好的Demo等你们测试，也希望即将发售的正式版中你们同样也能玩得愉快。

notes.title: 玩累了《王国之泪》来看看《十字军骑士》好吗？首次Demo测试今日开启！
notes.notes:
各位尊敬的骑士们你们好啊，我是吟游诗人小琪。不知道《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》发售之后，各位骑士们有没有睡过一个安稳觉，反正小琪我肯定是没有的。当然，我才没有熬夜打游戏呢，是在加班赶进度，没错，是在赶进度。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/f93085bf16554035300b5505e770fff6b048b186.gif[/img]

      之前线下活动之后，有很多骑士都来问过我，什么时候才能亲自上手“玩”到这款游戏，于是我们加急开启了少量的核心测试，也得到了不错的反馈，但是考虑到有很多关注过我们的骑士还在焦急等待，因此老国王在深思熟虑之后，表示加班加点也要让这些骑士们“上车”。于是我在此郑重宣布，《十字军骑士》首次大规模Demo测试将于本月30日也就是今天正式开启，测试时间为期一周，可喜可贺！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/f93085bf16554035300b5505e770fff6b048b186.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/656847f7ee74fb6010b39e2438c53c39ab4637e7.jpg[/img]

各位骑士们可以打开Steam平台，搜索《十字军骑士》，选择《十字军骑士》demo版本。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/1032efa7d5f71e92d87c4ba2a1ed3190817bfa27.png[/img]

点进去之后，可以看到免费下载的按钮，下载安装之后，就可以和小琪一起愉快的开始游戏了。如果在游玩期间，遇到任何问题或者BUG，都欢迎各位加入我们的QQ骑士群：729921218，忠实的护卫军竭诚为您服务。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/2fb16eff1d65291096ae28d4ad91901161890536.png[/img]

相较于此前的线下试玩，作为本次大规模测试，我们也准备了大量的游戏内容供骑士们体验。比如，我们将开放游戏的第一章和第二章全部内容供各位体验，除了能玩到改编自波兰名著的主线剧情之外，我们还加入了大量的随机任务和角色专属任务。同时还增添了一些新功能，例如主角在完成1-5的剧情线之后可以完成转职任务，之后就能在2个大招中随意切换，特殊NPC入队之后将会在营地常驻，还包括一些新的剧情演出。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/0adebacd3578f6e48551d6c28a6d3a0f713fe397.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/c0f4713ccf993526f4b36e5a7f900a4f73385d3c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/5bc3f3fd5dbe89b3d201fc44e93ed2d47714685e.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/13fe87bf364652fc1f1698e4703bbedb951583c2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/563acea1aded4784d6d6871f104e4cd508685ce9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/846955fbf3445480520a0a5fb6d88fcec2a001ec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/0347cda62cd21af3dce5e5a380e2b573fbdae8e7.jpg[/img]

总之，如果玩累了《王国之泪》不妨来试试我们这款“新口味”的独立游戏，我们也衷心希望能听到各位骑士们的真实反馈，以便后续打磨和优化，作为一个国产独立游戏小团队，我们势必用最大的诚意回报支持我们的骑士们，也期望《十字军骑士》能不负骑士之名，为各位带来愉快的游戏体验。

notes.title: Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross has been nominated for Best Artwork.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/5202b8f07f76a3d2f4c9b49134def241b1402d87.png[/img]
Hello, respected knights. I am the bard Xiao Qi. 

I have good news to share with you all. 
Recently, in the 15th "Golden Dolphin Award" game competition, "Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross" was nominated for the Best Game Art (Domestic and Foreign) award. Many knights may not be familiar with this award, so let me briefly introduce it.
The "Golden Dolphin Award" game competition is one of the important events of the Xiamen International Animation Festival. The event is hosted by the Xiamen Municipal Government and organized by the Xiamen International Animation Festival Committee. 

Since the registration started in March, it has attracted a large number of game developers and teams from home and abroad, receiving 225 game entries from 10 countries and regions, including many student team works and independent masterpieces.
This time, 64 works entered the final evaluation (with multiple nominations), including 26 main awards, 13 best planning awards, 10 best art awards, 10 Strait Star awards, and 15 best student games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/c706d65e0297c184d0a52f103a7c490b9fdac97a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/a92c03dc845637be382fffaa50a2439a31fbeb39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/bade64398815f9d256d626294dbf0fed35fc1279.png[/img]

To be honest, as a domestic independent game, it is not easy to create a distinctive art style. Therefore, we have invested a lot of effort in order to make more exquisite art style and game graphics with limited resources. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/78e13f22326abbf0e59ddbdd2b191fcd4882057b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/c9fc50643e3c1b7d3161dfe69a6bdb0454f44101.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/5a8cebe0cd071723b620d49f5c522ec71537b072.png[/img]

For a long time, we have been making a lot of adjustments and polishing to the art in the game, including game UI, character portraits, dynamic effects, and skill effects, etc. After a lot of modifications and iterations, we finally achieved the current appearance you see now.

Even so, we are still trying our best to further improve the game to make all the knights feel that it is worth their money when they purchase it. Recently, many knights have shown a great interest in "Crusader Knight" and are eager to know the price. Due to certain reasons, Xiao Qi cannot officially announce it here. But I can confidently tell you that the price is absolutely reasonable and unbelievable.

Finally, thank you all for your recognition, and also to the knights who have been following us all along. "Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross" is honored to have you with us.

notes.title: We are setting out for the 11th Chengdu World Animation Exhibition！
notes.notes:
Hello, Honorable knights.

 I am the wandering bard Xiaoqi. How did you all feel about the "simple and plain" promotional video released a few days ago? Many noble knights pointed out to me that there were too few female characters displayed and suggested adding more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/78b072fab00e3e3fadedf5ec09ed720687272e7a.png[/img]

After hearing such a sincere request, so I quickly reported it to the old King. After careful consideration, the King waved his hand and expressed his desire to personally embark on a journey to the upcoming "11th Chengdu World Animation Exhibition."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/0330273015b40059221f9dc2493e61cf89fc76ef.png[/img]

In order to allow all the knights to have more opportunities to experience the unique charm of their female character companions, we have also prepared the latest version of the game for the first public trial at the exhibition, waiting for all the noble knights to experience it firsthand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/f31f706d3c0b1bd18b1993c222cea71221a384de.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/8b8f5d5326e5e853888c09a7b6a511635e6cccdf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/6786fa62f58352fecd0404d0585911ee993a28a1.png[/img]

Of course, we have also prepared rich rewards for all knights who come to challenge. Here, Xiaoqi can reveal a small piece of insider information: the old king has specially prepared a batch of mysterious rewards to commend those knights who can successfully complete the challenge. They are said to be some heart-pumping rewards... cough cough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/9f2e7d1bc07af25b8905cb39be2e47ae506410ae.png[/img]

On April 29th, we will be waiting for all the knights' challenges at the exhibition booth located slightly to the right of the center of the 11th Chengdu World Animation Exhibition (please refer to the diagram below for details). Knights who want to be the first to try out the latest game and interact with the girls in the game should not miss out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/dcfab811830deedc1e5d2f1635344a79623d7284.png[/img]

Finally, we solemnly announce our knight QQ group again: 729921218. The latest online demo testing is currently in full swing and will be publicly available soon. Knights who have not yet joined the organization should hurry up!

notes.title: “The Knights of the cross” is about to start a new round of internal testing!
notes.notes:
Hello, respected knights! I am the bard Xiaoqi, and I bring you the latest information about "The Knights of the cross". After our last announcement, the "old king" was pleased, but he mentioned that text alone wasn't enough and a promotional video was needed. He provided a substantial budget to the ministers to create an epic promotional video to match the game's story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/a4beff2704665647a49f9ff7d12e587ff428306b.png[/img]

As the ministers were struggling to figure out how to create a Hollywood-level promotional video with a limited budget, a brave warrior made an inspiring statement: "We are an independent small team and we should promote a spirit of simplicity. We may not be able to create a Hollywood-level promotional video, but it definitely won't fit our independent team's image."

After several sleepless nights, the "simple version" of the Knights of the cross new promotional video was finally completed. In this grand epic adventure, all you brave knights will experience many temptations, including beautiful women, wealth, and power.

I also want to secretly reveal that the first group of adventure knights has already begun recruiting. By joining the mysterious knight order below, you can obtain a rare qualification to be part of the first wave of adventurers. We Need You!

notes.title: Dear respected knights, thank you for your long wait！
notes.notes:
Dear respected knights, thank you for your long wait. I am the bard Xiaoqi, from "Crusader Knight", dedicated to becoming a great writer capable of creating enduring masterpieces! Recently, I have been collecting various interesting stories and information from all over this continent, and after months of tireless efforts, I have finally returned with my latest findings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/520d4405df201ca9a96dd4c18c45815215bc9a13.png[/img]

Currently, our development progress is nearing completion, and all brave knights will soon embark on a brand-new journey.

In this upcoming adventure, you will meet many beautiful companions in the game, and in the end, you will have wives and concubines aplenty .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/82618b918bcd4ebcf9cd480a1d4b61bb82d08cc2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/37f6b95f381a8eda43c2a5968e07d94a7f718e93.png[/img]

You will experience an epic storyline provided by the Nobel Prize-winning literary masterpiece "Crusader Knight" in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42772025/da8a6f24c5fe64715f2a50b5e6ec527b5700f2d8.png[/img]
